# Spiritual Lesson Plans

> Free, Creative Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) Sunday school and youth-group lesson plans rooted in
> Christian Science and the Bible, explicitly open to every faith background. Each lesson is
> written independently for the age it's delivered to — not simplified down from one script —
> across five age bands from early elementary through adult, plus a printable handout per lesson.

Written for Christian Science Sunday school teachers and other Christian educators looking for
free, spiritually grounded, developmentally appropriate discussion and activity lessons. No
account, no cost, no organization — every lesson starts from the premise that a young person is
already whole and already loved. All content is free to use, adapt, and share under CC BY-SA 4.0.

## Lessons

- [Big Ego, Little Ego](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/big-ego-little-ego): You live inside the most little-e-ego-saturated environment ever built. Here’s the version of you it’s covering up. (Grade 3-5, Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [Does God Make My Decisions For Me?](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/does-god-make-my-decisions): A practical way to move through the toughest choices. (Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [Finding the Bigger "Us"](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/finding-the-bigger-us): A practical way to stop picking sides. (K-2, Grade 3-5, Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [Grief Doesn't Need Fixing](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/grief-doesnt-need-fixing): The real difference between grief you saw coming and grief that blindsided you, a strengths-based way to hold both, and why adjusting to a changed life is work — hard, honest, ongoing — that comfort accompanies rather than replaces. (K-2, Grade 3-5, Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [Is God Keeping Score?](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/is-god-keeping-score): Why the God you were handed might not be the God who’s actually there — and what changes the moment you switch pictures. (K-2, Grade 3-5, Grade 6-8, Age 21+)
- [Is Regret a Fair and Just Teacher?](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/is-regret-a-fair-teacher): A practical path from a hard decision to moving forward — without pretending it didn’t happen. (Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [LGBTQIA+ Youth and Spiritual Learning](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/lgbtqia-youth-and-spiritual-learning): Is there anyone in the world who shouldn’t have access to Truth? A lesson on belonging that works whether you’re figuring out your own identity or a friend’s. (Teen)
- [Learning to Hear the Nudge](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/learning-to-hear-the-nudge): A lesson on inner guidance — distinguishing genuine nudges from anxious noise, with practice on small decisions. (Grade 3-5, Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [Lonely in a Crowded Room](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/lonely-in-a-crowded-room): What that ache is actually telling you — and what’s still true underneath it. (Grade 3-5, Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [Off Days Are Allowed](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/off-days-are-allowed): Feeling disconnected doesn’t mean you’re doing it wrong. (K-2, Grade 3-5, Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [Scared About the News](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/scared-about-the-news): Readiness was never about outrunning the next disaster — it’s a description of who’s already got you. (K-2, Grade 3-5, Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [Seven Names, One Journey](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/seven-synonyms-and-three-degrees): Two of Christian Science’s most foundational ideas, unpacked for anyone — no faith background, and no prior exposure to Christian Science, required. (K-2, Grade 3-5, Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [Soul: Another Name for God](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/soul-another-name-for-god): Reading, symbolism, a creative class definition, and real life — Soul as one of the seven synonyms for God in Christian Science. (Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [Suffer It to Be So, Now](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/suffer-it-to-be-so-now): You don’t need your life figured out to be allowed to rest in it, right now. (K-2, Grade 3-5, Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [Talking About the Increase of Pornography Use in Our World](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/talking-about-pornography-use): “A steady, shame-free way in — because a habit is a cloud passing in front of the sun, not the sun itself.” (Teen)
- [The Pull You Feel — In Tune or Out?](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/the-pull-you-feel): Attraction isn’t the villain and it isn’t the boss — this lesson gives you a real test for what’s actually running it. (Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [Trust the Mover](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/trust-the-mover): What to do with real disappointment when your plans fall apart. (K-2, Grade 3-5, Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [When Someone Feels Like the Enemy](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/when-someone-feels-like-the-enemy): Why “love your enemies” isn’t the same as “there are no enemies.” (Grade 3-5, Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [Words That Open Doors](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/words-that-open-doors): Old language, old thoughts — and making the sacred make sense today. (Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)
- [You Are Not the Struggle](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/lessons/not-the-struggle): Can you be uncomfortable — and still be whole? Same paradox at every age, anchored in the performance anxiety of trying to seem like you have it together. (Grade 6-8, Teen, Age 21+)

## Optional

- [For You](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/for-you): a page for the young person reading a lesson themselves — how to use these lessons solo, with a friend, or handed up to a mentor, plus the Not Broken experience and the mood picker
- [Not Broken](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/not-broken): a three-minute interactive experience on wholeness as the starting point, not a repair job — open to anyone, teen through adult
- [For Mentors](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/for-mentors): facilitator safety guidelines and how the age-band system works
- [What We Believe](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/what-we-believe): plain-language explainer on Christian Science, including how it differs from the doctrine of original sin
- [About](https://www.spirituallessonplans.org/about): what this project is and its licensing
